## Resource / topic

What does this add, and why is it relevant to inference engineering?

## Evidence

Links to upstream source, docs, papers or reproducible tests.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked for duplicates.
- [ ] Links point to a stable primary source.
- [ ] Descriptions are neutral and accurate.
- [ ] I called out archived / historical projects.
- [ ] Any performance claim includes methodology and provenance.
